The Analytics Consulting team at Komodo Health specializes in providing advanced analytics solutions to healthcare organizations, leveraging real-world data to drive insights and decision-making.
This role exists on the Analytics Consulting team to ensure the delivery of high-quality analytics products and services to our clients. The consultant plays a crucial role in scoping analyses, driving client satisfaction, business growth, and innovation within the company.
Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have…
Successfully delivered complex analytics projects on time and within budget, exceeding client expectations.
Built strong, collaborative relationships with key client stakeholders, resulting in high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business.
Conducted statistical analyses, constructed and fit mathematical models, answered questions using complex datasets.
Implemented process improvements that enhanced the efficiency and effectiveness of the Analytics Consulting team.
Developed the skills and capabilities of team members, fostering a high-performing and engaged team culture.
Contributed to the growth of the company by identifying and pursuing new business opportunities within existing client accounts.
Demonstrated thought leadership in healthcare analytics, both internally and externally, through presentations, publications, and industry events.
Deepened your domain expertise across multiple key areas of interest to our clients, including but not limited to areas such as projections, market landscaping, patient journey, line-of-therapy based analytics, segmentation & targeting, and analytical support for commercial assessments, forecasting, and BD & Licensing.

s.h: These are the essential job duties you will be responsible for …

Manage the end-to-end delivery of analytics projects, from scoping and planning to execution and delivery.
Translate ambiguous business questions into tractable data analysis projects.
Interpret and investigate data and statistical questions that arise through the delivery of client work.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Data Science, Engineering, and Product Management, to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, addressing any concerns or issues that may arise during the project lifecycle.
Monitor project progress and performance, proactively identifying risks and implementing mitigation strategies as needed.
Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in healthcare analytics, incorporating new insights and technologies into our service offerings.

Strong project management skills, with experience leading cross-functional teams and managing client relationships.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages such as SQL, Python, or R.

Great healthcare technology requires a bridge between technical solutioning and real-world strategy to drive true value. If you thrive at that intersection, Komodo Health is looking for a Technical Engagement Manager to join us in our mission to reduce the global burden of disease
In this role, you’ll serve as a strategic technical lead, bridging the gap between Komodo’s data ecosystem and our customers’ most critical business objectives.

You will lead the end-to-end delivery of our most sophisticated AI tooling—specifically Marmot, our proprietary AI engine—integrating Komodo’s data into the core of industry leading healthcare organizations.

Your responsibility extends beyond the initial implementation as you continue to engineer creative solutions and maintain a feedback loop to ensure that our technology solves real-world patient problems.

Lead with AI: Become the go-to expert on Komodo’s AI capabilities, helping customers navigate the frontier of machine learning in healthcare.
Own the Outcome: Be the primary customer-facing technical resource responsible for ensuring delivery milestones are achieved on schedule. This includes leading requirements gathering, executing hands-on data deliveries, and turning ambiguous client workflows into concrete realities.
Be the Customer Champion: Serve as the primary internal advocate for your customers, ensuring their technical priorities and pain points are understood and addressed by Komodo’s internal product teams.
Orchestrate Internal Collaboration: Act as the central point of contact between Sales, Delivery, Support, and Product to ensure internal teams remain aligned on each customer’s unique technical roadmap.
Operate with Precision: Eliminate ambiguity by establishing a clear source of truth for every project. You will build and maintain the thorough technical documentation, roadmap tracking, and system hygiene required to keep our internal teams synchronized and executing seamlessly.
Influence Change: Proactively identify functional gaps in data or workflow requirements and design the necessary technical "bridges" to ensure a seamless experiences.
Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have accomplished…
Obtained an understanding of Komodo’s Healthcare Map, platform, and suite of products.
Executed customer product delivery on schedule and at high quality, driving in-depth technical discussions and hands-on data delivery.
Contributed to Komodo’s playbooks and internal knowledge base.

s.h: These are the essential job duties you will be responsible for
s.t:
Scope and solution both standard and non-standard workflows to determine the optimal path for delivering client value.
Facilitate detailed data conversations with Komodo’s Legal and Compliance teams, distilling and communicating compliance boundaries to stakeholders.
Identify opportunities for automation and scalability within our delivery workflows to transform repetitive tasks into streamlined, repeatable processes.
Mobilize cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Success) to swiftly diagnose and resolve technical customer bottlenecks and bespoke requests.

Core Data Skills: Strong foundational knowledge in data queries (SQL or similar), database schemas, and data architecture concepts.
AI Fluency: A strong understanding of core AI/ML concepts and an excitement to master Komodo’s product ecosystem. You are proficient in using generative AI tools to accelerate workflow automation and your own development productivity.
Cloud & Platform Infrastructure: A foundational, operational understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure, Snowflake data warehousing, and API technologies.
Workflow Automation: Hands-on experience automating data execution tasks and pipelines using Snowflake Tasks, Airflow, or scripting languages.

Cross-Functional Technical Communication: Experience collaborating directly with a diverse range of stakeholders, from engineers to non-technical business leaders and customer stakeholders. You can easily break down complex technical hurdles into clear, actionable updates for a CEO or a Data Engineer alike
Relentless Coordination: A track record of managing multiple complex, multi-stakeholder projects with high accuracy, proactive communication, and rigorous internal system hygiene.
Growth Mindset & Problem Solving: Intellectual curiosity and an excitement for new challenges. You are a solutions-oriented thinker who enjoys navigating ambiguous situations and finding strategic ways forward through complex roadblocks.
Passion for HealthTech: You are genuinely motivated by the prospect of using data to improve patient lives.
Collaborative Leadership: A dedicated teammate who proactively shares knowledge and best practices to elevate the quality of work across the entire team.

The Reputation Strategy and Research team sits within the Strategic Communications division at Teneo. We help our clients take a strategic approach to reputation, so they can win the trust their business needs.

We design processes that help clients make defining strategic choices about reputation and build the positioning, narrative and communications strategy they need. We develop cutting-edge research techniques to inform these decisions, identifying priority audiences and the most persuasive approaches.

Our approach is audience-led and evidence-based, using research and insight at every stage of our projects.

Determine where audiences stand on client-critical issues and what drives their perceptions

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.
We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Texas to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.
You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build.

You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly.

Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.
You will travel regularly within your region, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with local elected officials, government agencies, economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the data center markets you cover

Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate
Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media
Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement
Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced
Work with the Communications team to develop proactive, locally relevant messaging
Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships
Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use
Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

Direct experience working for or engaging with local governments and a broad set of community stakeholders on behalf of large infrastructure, construction, energy, or technology projects, with a working understanding of how local politics and community dynamics actually play out
A skilled relationship and coalition builder who earns trust with a diverse group of stakeholders, and who maintains relationships through difficult conversations
The ability to represent a company credibly in public settings — town halls, hearings, press interviews
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn a complex operational plan into plain language that a local official or reporter can understand and respond to
The ability to work independently, get up to speed quickly on complex policy issues, and manage multiple concurrent engagements across different markets without losing track of any of them
Based in Texas or willing to relocate there, and prepared to travel regularly across the region

frog Data

Join our frog data team and help shape the future of data and AI consulting. We help brands unlock the value and power of data and AI – through the lense of customer experience.

You’ll work at the intersection our solutions focus on CX Data and AI, strategy, activation & personalisation, analytics, insights, measurement and advanced data science, turning complex data into transformative solutions that drive real impact.

If you’re passionate about using data and AI to create smarter, more human experiences, this is your opportunity to lead change and make a difference.

We are seeking a skilled Senior Consultant with hands-on experience helping organisations deliver value within customer, marketing or commercial domains through data and insights.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in one (or more) of the following areas: customer behaviour analytics, marketing, commercial, web, or product analytics, and possess domain knowledge in marketing, customer, digital, and commercial sectors.

Additionally, the candidate should have strong project management and people management skills.

What We Look For

We are seeking a skilled Senior Consultant experienced in one or more data-related roles—such as Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Architect, or Data Strategist. You will have a combination of some of the following personal and professional attributes:

CX Data & Insights SME – Hands-on experience working with data within behaviour analytics, marketing, CRM, commercial, web, CDPs or product analytics with core focus in customer experience. Familiar with a range of 1st, 2nd and 3rd party data sources - including transactional/EPOS, digital, retailer, social, loyalty etc
Delivery Excellence - Experience developing and implementing insight solutions, MarTech / data driven CX solutions or ML/AL solutions. Proven experience owning workstreams including planning, execution, and successful delivery of insights or AI/ML POCs, MVPs and production grade solutions.
Data Visualisation Experience - Utilise visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau to present data insights effectively.
Cloud expertise - Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure) and tools for data analytics or data science, and experience with data modelling and data management
Collaborative team player – Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges and create valuables products/solutions
Excellent Communicator – Strong written communication, presentation and data driven storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to stakeholders
Innovative Mind - A strong interest and experience with the latest advancements in data, AI, machine learning, and data science space
It Would Be a Bonus If You Have
Experience in primary growth sectors; CPR (Consumer Products & Retail), ETU (Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications), and PS (Public Sector).
Familiarity with Agentic AI
Client delivery experience (for either internal or external customers)
Familiarity with data analytics tools or programming languages (such as Python, SQL or R)
Familiarity with ethical considerations and best practices in data analytics, AI and data science.
People Manager - People management skills, including mentoring, guiding, and developing junior team members.

About Capgemini Invent

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries.

With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs.

It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion.
